title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer with 3–5 years of experience in designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Azure services, cloud security, networking, monitoring, automation, and troubleshooting. The candidate will work closely with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to ensure secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy, configure, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure, including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and related services.
* Manage Azure networking components such as VNets, subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, and DNS.
* Implement and maintain cloud security best practices, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and access policies.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and resource utilization using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Azure CLI, PowerShell, Azure Automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM/Bicep templates.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with DevOps teams using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Manage backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability configurations using appropriate Azure services.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize service disruptions.
* Optimize Azure resource utilization and cloud expenditure by implementing cost-monitoring, resource-tagging, and cost-optimization practices.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with development, security, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to support application deployments, cloud migrations, and environment management.
* Follow organizational policies and industry best practices for cloud governance, compliance, security, and operational management.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure.
* Good understanding of core Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and Azure Monitor.
* Practical experience with Azure networking, identity and access management, security configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep).
* Understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of cloud security principles, cost management, and resource governance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience with cloud migration projects and hybrid cloud environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, incident management, and change management processes.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Work Location: In person

title: Director - SLED Proposals & Pursuit Excellence
description:
**Director - SLED Proposals & Pursuit Excellence**
==================================================

**What are we looking for:**
============================

**We are not looking for someone whose idea of proposal leadership is reviewing documents after everyone else has finished writing them. We are looking for a builder, problem solver and owner. The right person will see an ambiguous RFP, a fragmented team and an aggressive deadline and instinctively create structure around it. They will ask the difficult questions early, push teams to make decisions, challenge weak assumptions, refuse to submit mediocre work and take personal ownership of the quality of every major pursuit. This person should be comfortable recommending a No-Bid when the facts do not support pursuit, and equally comfortable mobilizing a cross-functional team when Dash decides to compete.**


**Pursuit Leadership & Win Strategy**
=====================================

* Own the proposal lifecycle from qualified opportunity through final submission, clarification, oral presentation and post-award handoff.
* Lead structured Bid/No-Bid decisions based on strategic fit, contract access, customer knowledge, incumbent position, competition, past performance, technical capability, delivery feasibility, economics and probability of win.
* Establish win themes, differentiators, competitive positioning and evaluator-focused response strategies.
* Challenge teams when the solution, evidence or value proposition is not strong enough to win.
* Participate in strategic capture planning for high-value pursuits before RFP release.

**Proposal Governance**
=======================

* Establish and enforce a repeatable Dash proposal methodology covering kickoff, compliance matrix, proposal outline, writing assignments, solution reviews, executive reviews, production and submission.
* Run a daily or near-daily pursuit war room covering pipeline, active capture, proposal status, risks, dependencies and next actions.
* Ensure every submission is compliant, responsive, persuasive and delivered on time.
* Establish clear ownership and escalation paths so issues are identified early rather than discovered near the deadline.

**Team Leadership**
===================

* Lead the Capture, Proposal Development and Technical Bid/Solution functions in India.
* Coach proposal writers and capture professionals to become stronger strategic contributors rather than task executors.
* Set quality standards and provide direct editorial and strategic feedback.
* Build a culture where people take ownership, communicate risks early and solve problems rather than simply escalating them.

**Content & Knowledge Management**
==================================

* Develop and govern Dash's reusable public-sector proposal content library.
* Maintain high-quality reusable content for corporate qualifications, technical capabilities, management approaches, transition, staffing, past performance, resumes, security, quality, cloud, data, AI and application modernization.
* Create templates, checklists, review criteria and pursuit playbooks; retire outdated or weak content.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**
===============================

* Work closely with U.S. business development, account leaders, solution architects, delivery leaders, finance, legal/compliance, recruiting and executive leadership.
* Convert SME input into a cohesive customer-facing story and hold owners accountable for timely inputs.
* Support oral presentations, demonstrations, clarification responses and negotiations when required.

**Continuous Improvement & Metrics**
====================================

* Track opportunities reviewed, go decisions, submissions, compliance defects, shortlist/interview rate, awards, win rate, cycle time and reasons for loss.
* Conduct structured win/loss reviews and convert lessons learned into process improvements.
* Identify responsible uses of AI and proposal technology to improve research, content reuse, compliance checking and productivity without compromising confidentiality or accuracy.

**Required Experience & Skills**
================================

* 12+ years of experience in proposals, bids, capture, presales or government contracting.
* Significant direct experience supporting U.S. government opportunities; strong SLED experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated ownership of complex IT services or professional-services proposals.
* Strong understanding of RFP/RFQ/RFI requirements, compliance matrices, evaluation criteria and public-sector procurement processes.
* Exceptional written and spoken business English and strong executive-level editing skills.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams under aggressive deadlines and challenging senior stakeholders constructively.
* Experience developing proposal processes, templates, content libraries and quality standards.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**
=========================================

* APMP certification or meaningful Shipley-style proposal/capture experience.
* Experience with IT services, application development, cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, staffing or digital transformation.
* Experience with U.S. state contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, MSP/VMS programs or large government IDIQ-style vehicles.
* Experience managing an India-based proposal/capture team supporting U.S. operations.

**The Personality We Are Looking For**
======================================

* Takes ownership even when the problem technically belongs to someone else.
* Hates surprises and surfaces issues before they become emergencies.
* Is comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.
* Can be demanding without becoming difficult to work with.
* Cares deeply about winning but is disciplined enough to recommend a No-Bid.
* Asks how the team can make the process better after both wins and losses.
* Does not need constant supervision or detailed instructions.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first six months, this leader should have established a predictable capture-to-submission operating model, clear pursuit gates, reusable proposal assets, consistent review practices and measurable visibility into why Dash is winning or losing government pursuits.

title: AI Consultant
description:
**About the E2M:**

E2M Solutions works as a trusted white-label partner for digital agencies. We support agencies with consistent and reliable delivery through services such as website design, web development, eCommerce, SEO, AI SEO, PPC, AI automation, and content writing. Founded on strong business ethics, we are an equal opportunity organization powered by 300+ experienced professionals, partnering with 400+ digital agencies across the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and Australia. At E2M, we value ownership, consistency, and people who are committed to doing meaningful work and growing together. If you’re someone who dreams big and has the gumption to make them come true, E2M has a place for you.

**About the Role**

* You will own AI engagements for our agency clients, from the first discovery call to live, adopted solutions. Our clients know AI matters but are held back by manual work, inconsistent AI output, and disconnected tools.
* You will find where time and money are being lost, define what to build and in what order, make sound architecture and security calls, and lead an engineering pod to ship production-ready systems. You are the person clients trust when things go right, and just as importantly, when they go wrong.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Discovery and Assessment**

* Run a structured 3 to 4 week AI assessment with stakeholders across PPC, SEO, content, project management, sales, and leadership.
* Use pre-call audit sheets to quantify manual work (task, frequency, hours) and steer toward the highest-value workflows.
* Map workflows end to end (tools, handoffs, data sources, failure points) and reframe solution-first requests into the real underlying problem.

**2. AI Blueprint and Proposal**

* Author the client AI Blueprint: 10 to 30+ use cases, each with current process, proposed solution and stack, dependencies, expected outcome, and timeline.
* Prioritise with an Impact vs. Effort matrix and recommend 2 to 3 high-impact starting automations.
* Design phased roadmaps (quick wins, leadership visibility, revenue and lead generation, then agentic systems) that build on existing tools.
* Present the plan to founders, covering team model, delivery cadence, testing approach (for example shadow mode), and pricing.

**3. Solution Architecture**

* Lead platform, hosting, and build vs. buy decisions with client technical teams (Azure AI Foundry, Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, multi-model).
* Define secure access: least privilege, read-only API scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit trails, and exclusion of sensitive data.
* Design knowledge systems: RAG pipelines, vector search trade-offs, tiered context management, MCP connectors, and reusable Claude Skills.
* Test feasibility on client APIs before scoping, manage cost-to-serve, and make deliberate "prototype now, re-architect later" calls.

**4. Delivery and Account Management**

* Run weekly syncs per account: demo progress, collect feedback, manage change requests, and reprioritise.
* Turn feedback into clear, testable requirements for the pod and hold the line on MVP dates.
* Own AI output quality: lead root cause analysis on failures, put safe interim processes in place, and track accuracy over time.
* Lead client communication on security incidents, covering impact, actions, and timelines.

**5. Adoption and Training**

* Train client teams through live sessions, SOPs, and follow-up coaching so solutions are used after launch.
* Ensure AI output matches each client’s brand voice and coach clients on giving feedback that improves it.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Direct the delivery pod: set requirements, review builds, and enforce a production-ready definition of done, edge cases included.
* Mentor junior team members toward client-facing roles through frameworks, scenario reviews, and call shadowing.

**Requirements:**

**1. Experience**

* 2+ years building custom AI solutions (LLM apps, RAG, agents, workflow automation) that reached production.
* 4+ years in client-facing delivery (Project or Program Manager, Solutions Consultant, CSM, or Account Manager), ideally in an agency or services company.
* Track record of owning multiple concurrent client engagements end to end.

**2. Technical Skills**

* **AI:** Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, prompt and context engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector search, output evaluation.
* **Build:** Python with FastAPI or LangGraph, MCP servers and connectors.
* **Integration:** APIs, webhooks, OAuth scopes, SSO/SAML, RBAC, secure credential handling, plus one cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and Supabase or Postgres.
* **Agency stack:** GA4, Search Console, Google, Meta and Bing Ads, Klaviyo, SEO data providers, HubSpot, and PM tools (Teamwork, Basecamp, ClickUp, Monday, Productive).
* **Judgment:** Can sketch an architecture, estimate effort, and spot feasibility risks without an engineer in the room.

**3. Consulting Skills**

* Facilitates discovery workshops that surface the real problem.
* Quantifies ROI (hours saved, turnaround time, cost avoided) and uses it to prioritise.
* Writes clear proposals, Blueprints, requirements, and SOPs.
* Presents confidently to executives and discusses pricing, phasing, and scope in plain business language.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience productising a custom AI solution across multiple clients.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent delivery certification.
* Consulting background with exposure to process improvement and quality frameworks.
* Experience with AI search visibility, SEO intelligence, or marketing analytics.

title: Senior CRM Data Integration Architect
description:
Job Description

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior CRM Data Integration Architect to lead end-to-end data integration projects for customer lifecycle marketing platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in data engineering, cloud data warehouses, event streaming, APIs, and CRM/Marketing Automation Platform (MAP) integrations.

The candidate will be responsible for designing scalable data integration architectures, leading technical discovery, defining identity and data models, and guiding engineering teams through implementation and quality assurance.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead technical discovery across data warehouses, Kafka, APIs, microservices, and legacy systems.
* Design data integration architecture, source-to-target mapping, identity models, and event/attribute taxonomies.
* Develop integration solutions using batch processing, real-time streaming, and reverse ETL.
* Design and implement integrations between data platforms and marketing automation tools.
* Manage data migration, historical backfills, reconciliation, implementation QA, and cutover planning.
* Define consent, subscription, data suppression, and privacy management frameworks.
* Review API integrations, data payloads, error handling, retries, and deduplication mechanisms.
* Prepare detailed architecture documents and implementation-ready technical specifications.
* Collaborate with client engineering teams and senior technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to presales, solution estimation, and reusable integration frameworks.

Mandatory Key Skills

* **Experience:** 7+ years in Data Engineering or Integration Architecture, including 2+ years in customer/marketing data systems.
* **Databricks:** Delta Lake, Spark SQL/PySpark, Workflows, Unity Catalog, and data pipelines.
* **Snowflake:** SQL, data modelling, Streams/Tasks, Snowpipe, and performance optimisation.
* **Apache Kafka:** Topics, partitions, consumers, schema registry, CDC, and production streaming integrations.
* **CRM/Marketing Automation Platforms:** Hands-on integration experience with at least one of Braze, Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Customer.io, Iterable, or Klaviyo.
* **API Integration:** REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, pagination, retries, and error handling.
* **Programming Languages:** Strong Python and SQL skills.
* **Data Modelling:** Identity resolution and multi-entity, multi-brand, or multi-tenant data architecture.
* **Consent Management:** Experience with marketing and transactional consent/subscription models.
* **Client Management:** Ability to conduct technical discovery, prepare architecture blueprints, and communicate with client engineering teams.

Good-to-Have Skills

* AWS: Lambda, S3, Glue, Step Functions, EventBridge, and IAM.
* Salesforce Data Cloud and Sales/Service Cloud.
* CDP and reverse ETL tools: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, or Census.
* Middleware/iPaaS: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi.
* JavaScript/TypeScript, dbt, and GDPR/CCPA compliance exposure.

Pay: Up to ₹2,800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in Data Engineering or Integration Architecture?
* Do you have at least 2 years of experience working with customer or marketing data systems?
* Do you have hands-on production experience with all three: Databricks, Snowflake, and Apache Kafka?
* Have you personally delivered an end-to-end integration from a data warehouse or streaming platform to a marketing automation platform?
* Which marketing automation platforms have you integrated with?

title: Senior Manager IT
description:

If you have experience with **PLM,****ERP,****CAD****integrations,****cloud****migration,****microservices,****Java,****and****enterprise****architecture**, this is your opportunity to work on cutting\-edge engineering and manufacturing transformation programs.  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* Define and own the Windchill solution architecture, roadmap, standards, and implementation strategy aligned with business and enterprise goals.
* Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into scalable and effective PLM solutions.
* Design and configure Windchill solutions covering product data, CAD management, workflows, lifecycles, roles, teams, and access controls.

Your profile

* Proven track record of designing and implementing integrations between PLM, ERP, ALM, CAD, IoT, document management systems, portals, and middleware platforms.

* Strong technical leadership with experience in team mentoring, solution reviews, issue resolution, and delivery ownership.
* Customer\-facing consulting experience, including stakeholder workshops, product demonstrations, pre\-sales support, RFP responses, and technical presentations.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Certifications such as PMP, TOGAF, PTC, Cloud, or Agile are an added advantage.
